config.expression:
concat(
  "Line ", {[default]Exchange/Alarm Flood/Simulator/TargetLine},
  "   |   ", numberFormat({[default]Exchange/Alarm Flood/Simulator/Progress}, "0"), "% of scenario",
  "   |   ", toString({[default]Exchange/Alarm Flood/Simulator/HoldSecs}), "s hold before auto-recovery")

config.script:
import exchange.alarmFlood.control
	# Starts the scenario phase machine -- no alarm is written directly.
	system.util.invokeAsynchronous(exchange.alarmFlood.control.simulateFlood)

# The Gmail look-alike over the Mailpit sink, where the Alarm Notification
	# Agent's emails land; exchange.demo.hosts derives its URL from the browser's host.
	exchange.demo.hosts.openMailbox(self.session.props.gateway.address)
